description: Pages and redirects scripts/deploy/verify-release.mjs checks on every deploy, before and after the switch. Each route must answer 200 from the new build, must not be the not-found page, and must render an <h1> and every string in 'contains'; its JS/CSS and images are checked too. Each redirect must answer its status in one hop with exactly 'to' as the Location, and 'to' must be a real page. Keep every entry live: remove one only in the same change that retires the page or the redirect (and a 'contains' only when the page stops rendering that markup), or every deploy will be refused.
